title: Flat and Solid Shapes
short: Tell flat shapes from solid shapes like cubes, cones, cylinders and spheres.
trouble: Children call a cube a square because they name the face they see.

blocks.html: You can name flat shapes. Solid shapes are not flat: you can pick them up and turn them.

blocks.name: k-pic
blocks.cap: Four solid shapes: a cube, a cylinder, a cone and a sphere.

blocks.html: Flat shapes lie flat, like a drawing. Solid shapes take up space, like a block or a ball.
A solid can have flat shapes on it. Each face of a cube is a square, but the whole cube is solid.

blocks.name: shapes
blocks.cap: Drag to turn the cube. Each face is a flat square.

blocks.title: A soup can
blocks.q: Is a soup can flat or solid? What shape is it?
steps: You can hold it, so it is solid.
Its ends are circles and its side is curved.

blocks.html: Calling a cube a square because you see one square face. Can you hold it and turn it? Then it is solid: a cube.
For grown-ups: Find solids in the kitchen: cans, oranges, boxes, cones. Ask your child to sort them into “rolls” and “does not roll.”
